cafe.name: Coffee
cafe.description: Coffee responds stage by stage, from pre-bloom to ripening. Juma-Agro builds the foliar program along the phenological calendar of the grove, with a defined product and rate for each window.
actua: No nutritional deficiencies across the phenological stages.
Physiological effect with readily assimilated nitrogen at pinhead and grain filling.
Phosphorus energy supply in the stages of highest demand.
Lower physiological oxidation and stronger endogenous defenses.
Higher flower set and production sustained through harvest.

0.title: Uneven bloom
0.desc: Flowering waves on different dates spread out ripening and complicate harvest.

1.title: Pinhead drop
1.desc: Newly formed fruit that drops before setting is a direct production loss in the block.

2.title: Incomplete filling
2.desc: Light, low-screen beans when energy and nutrition are short at peak demand.

3.title: Irregular ripening
3.desc: Fruit at different stages on the same plant compromises cup quality.

4.title: Grove without reserves
4.desc: A coffee plant that reaches harvest exhausted starts the next cycle weak and alternates yield.

products.name: Revigo Café ou Revigo Zn Plus
Revigo Café ou Revigo Zn Plus
Revigo Café ou Revigo Zn Plus

aminosan.desc: Higher flower set and production, from pre-bloom to grain filling.

fitofert.desc: Lowers physiological oxidation and strengthens endogenous defenses.

revigophos-amino.desc: Phosphorus energy supply at pinhead and grain filling.

kmep-ultra.desc: Potassium at grain filling and ripening, up to 3.0 L/ha.

acorda-ultra.desc: Root start for young coffee, by drench or fertigation.

aduban.desc: Conditions the root zone in young and rainfed coffee.

cafe.managementNote: When Aminosan is tank-mixed with Revigo Nitrogênio Plus, reduce the Revigo Nitrogênio Plus rate. Young coffee, after transplanting: Acorda Ultra 1.0 L/ha and Aduban 3.0 L/ha by drench or fertigation; Aminosan 300 ml/100 L of water and Revigo Zn Plus or Revigo Café 300 ml/100 L monthly; FitoFert 250 ml/100 L every 45 days.
cafe.source: Juma-Agro brochure · Foliar nutrition suggestions for coffee

soja.name: Soybeans
soja.description: Soybean concentrates the season in four windows: seed treatment, V4/V5, pre-bloom and pod set. The Juma-Agro program defines the product and rate for each of them.
actua: Uniform germination and a larger root system from seed treatment on.
Vegetative development and stress recovery at V4/V5.
Phosphorus energy and micronutrients while the yield structure is built.
Boron supplementation and higher flower set at pre-bloom.
Grain filling with the potentiator applied three times in the reproductive stage.
Better spray quality in every application.

0.title: Uneven stand
0.desc: Irregular germination and short roots compromise how much of the area actually produces.

1.title: Weak vegetative structure
1.desc: A crop that does not close the row loses light and reaches the reproductive stage small.

2.title: Flower abortion
2.desc: A flower that does not set a pod takes yield away before filling even starts.

3.title: Light grains
3.desc: Lack of energy and potassium at filling drives down final grain weight.

0.label: Phase 01
0.fase: Seed treatment, planting furrow or V2

acorda-ultra.desc: Uniform germination and a larger root system from planting.

aminosan.desc: Development and stress recovery at V4/V5 and pre-bloom.

revigophos-amino.desc: Phosphorus energy at V4/V5 and at pod set.

fitofert.desc: Lowers physiological oxidation through the reproductive stage.

kmep-ultra.desc: Potentiator, dislodging agent and grain filling.

redutan-sili-4.desc: Spray quality in every application of the program.

soja.managementNote: KMEP Ultra 1.0 L/ha in 3 applications at 10-day intervals, starting at pre-bloom. Redutan Sili-4 at 30 to 50 ml/100 L in every application.
soja.source: Juma-Agro brochure · Nutrition suggestions for soybean (2025)

milho.name: Corn
milho.description: Corn has a short window and demands precision at three moments: seed treatment, sixth to eighth leaf and pre-tasseling. That is where the Juma-Agro program works.
actua: Uniform germination and a larger root system at seed treatment.
Better development, flowering and ear and grain size.
Physiological effect with readily assimilated nitrogen at vegetative stage and pre-tasseling.
Phosphorus energy supply, with zinc and boron as micronutrients.
Lower physiological oxidation and stronger endogenous defenses before tasseling.
Better spray quality in every application.

0.title: Slow start
0.desc: A seedling that takes long to push roots loses days in a window that is already short.

1.title: Ear set below potential
1.desc: This is the stage where the plant defines rows and kernels per ear.

2.title: Stress at flowering
2.desc: Without nutrition and defense before the tassel, fertilization drops and the ear ends up gappy.

0.label: Phase 01
0.fase: Seed treatment, planting furrow or V2

acorda-ultra.desc: Uniform germination and deeper roots at seed treatment.

aminosan.desc: Development, flowering and ear and grain size.

revigophos-amino.desc: Phosphorus energy from the sixth leaf to pre-tasseling.

fitofert.desc: Endogenous defenses in the pre-tasseling window.

kmep-ultra.desc: Potentiator, dislodging agent and grain filling.

redutan-sili-4.desc: Spray quality in every application of the program.

milho.managementNote: When Aminosan and Revigo Nitrogênio Plus go into the same application, one of them should be used at 50% of the rate. KMEP Ultra 1.0 L/ha in 3 applications at 10-day intervals. Redutan Sili-4 at 30 to 50 ml/100 L in every application.
milho.source: Juma-Agro brochure · Nutrition suggestions for corn (2024)

cana.name: Sugarcane
cana.description: Sugarcane requires nutrition from planting to maturation, focusing on startup, tillering, and TCH. Juma-Agro offers specific solutions for each phase of the crop.
actua: Accelerated rooting in seedling planting.
Abundant tillering for a greater number of stalks per hectare.
Vigorous growth sustained throughout the cycle.
Resistance to water and thermal stress.
Uniform maturation for better industrial quality.

0.title: Slow seedling startup
0.desc: Seedlings with irregular sprouting that compromise the initial stand.

1.title: Low tillering
1.desc: Insufficient number of stalks per hectare limiting the TCH.

2.title: Nutritional deficit
2.desc: Irregular growth due to lack of adequate nutrition in each phase.

3.title: Uneven maturation
3.desc: Stalks in different stages hindering harvest management.

algodao.name: Cotton
algodao.description: Cotton defines profitability in the reproductive stage: from pre-bloom to 25 days after flowering, every application sustains boll retention. The Juma-Agro program covers six moments of the cycle.
actua: Root start at seed treatment and in the planting furrow.
Amino acids and phosphorus 20 days after germination.
Boron and calcium supplementation at pre-bloom and full bloom.
Physiological defense with FitoFert in both bloom windows.
Potassium and micronutrients 15 and 25 days after flowering.
Redutan Sili-4 in every application for better spray performance.

0.title: Slow start
0.desc: A seed that takes long to push roots delivers a small plant early in the vegetative stage.

1.title: Few flower buds
1.desc: Lack of boron and calcium in this window limits how many structures the plant sets.

2.title: Structure shedding
2.desc: Squares and bolls that drop before setting are a direct loss of harvestable cotton.

3.title: Incomplete filling
3.desc: Without potassium and micronutrients at the end, fiber stays below potential.

acorda-ultra.desc: Root start at seed treatment and in the planting furrow.

revigophos-amino.desc: Phosphorus energy in four of the six applications of the program.

fitofert.desc: Physiological defense at pre-bloom and full bloom.

redutan-sili-4.desc: Recommended in every application for better performance.

algodao.managementNote: Redutan Sili-4 in every application for better performance.
algodao.source: Juma-Agro brochure · Nutrition suggestion for cotton

feijao.name: Beans
feijao.description: Beans have a short cycle and react fast: what is missing at V4/V5 or pre-bloom is not recovered at grain filling. The Juma-Agro program covers the four windows of the cycle.
actua: Uniform germination and a larger root system from seed treatment on.
Vegetative development and stress recovery at V4/V5.
Phosphorus energy supply, with molybdenum and boron as micronutrients.
Lower physiological oxidation and stronger endogenous defenses.
Higher flower set at pre-bloom R5.
Grain filling with the potentiator applied three times in the reproductive stage.

0.title: Uneven stand
0.desc: Irregular emergence leaves gaps that the short bean cycle does not recover.

1.title: Weak vegetative stage
1.desc: A small plant early on reaches the reproductive stage without structure to hold pods.

2.title: Flower abortion
2.desc: A flower that drops before setting reduces pods per plant.

3.title: Light grains
3.desc: Lack of energy and calcium at filling takes weight and market appearance from the grain.

0.label: Phase 01
0.fase: Seed treatment, planting furrow or V2

acorda-ultra.desc: Uniform germination and a larger root system from planting.

aminosan.desc: Development and stress recovery at V4/V5 and pre-bloom.

revigophos-amino.desc: Phosphorus energy at V4/V5 and at pod set.

fitofert.desc: Lowers physiological oxidation through the reproductive stage.

kmep-ultra.desc: Potentiator, dislodging agent and grain filling.

redutan-sili-4.desc: Spray quality in every application of the program.

feijao.managementNote: KMEP Ultra 1.0 L/ha in 3 applications at 10-day intervals, starting at pre-bloom. Redutan Sili-4 at 30 to 50 ml/100 L in every application.
feijao.source: Juma-Agro brochure · Nutrition suggestions for beans (2024)

citros.name: Citrus
citros.description: Citrus works all year: vegetation, bloom, fruit filling and two plant maintenance rounds. The Juma-Agro program defines the product and rate for each of these steps.
actua: Early vegetation fed with amino acids, zinc and magnesium.
Physiological defense with FitoFert at pre-bloom and post-bloom.
Amino acids for fruit set and stress recovery.
Potassium and phosphorus at fruit filling.
Two plant maintenance rounds 45 days apart.
Aduban through fertigation to condition the root zone.

0.title: Weak flush
0.desc: A short vegetative flush leaves the tree with fewer flowering points.

1.title: Low fruit set
1.desc: A flower that does not set reduces the crop load before the season starts.

2.title: Physiological fruitlet drop
2.desc: Newly set fruit drops when nutrition is short right after bloom.

3.title: Size and brix below target
3.desc: Without potassium and phosphorus at this stage, fruit reaches neither size nor soluble solids.

4.title: Orchard exhausted after harvest
4.desc: A tree with no maintenance enters the next cycle with low reserves.

5.label: Phase 06
5.fase: 2nd plant maintenance (45 days after the first)

aminosan.desc: Present at vegetation, pre-bloom, fruit filling and maintenance.

fitofert.desc: Physiological defense at pre-bloom and post-bloom.

revigophos-amino.desc: Phosphorus energy at fruit filling and at the second maintenance.

aduban.desc: Conditions the root zone through fertigation, 20 ml per plant.

redutan-sili-4.desc: Spray quality in the orchard foliar applications.

citros.managementNote: Aduban through fertigation: 20 ml per plant at early vegetation, repeated in the first fruit filling application, plus 2 applications during plant maintenance.
citros.source: Juma-Agro brochure · Nutrition suggestions for citrus

batata.name: Potato
batata.description: Potato concentrates yield between hilling and day 60. The Juma-Agro program works on seed treatment, hilling and the block of applications through vegetative and reproductive development.
actua: Root development and initial start at seed treatment.
Better nutrient availability in the root zone.
Phosphorus energy supply through vegetative and reproductive development.
Lower physiological oxidation and stronger endogenous defenses.
Tuberization supported by weekly amino acid applications.
Tissue and tuber formation with calcium and magnesium.

0.title: Uneven sprouting
0.desc: Seed that sprouts off schedule leaves the field out of sync until harvest.

1.title: Poor root zone
1.desc: Roots with no available nutrients at hilling limit how many tubers are formed.

2.title: Size below market
2.desc: Lack of calcium, magnesium and phosphorus at filling costs the lot its grading.

2.label: Phase 03
2.fase: Vegetative and reproductive development (15 to 60 days)

acorda-ultra.desc: Root development and initial start, 1.0 L/ha.

aduban.desc: Makes nutrients available in the root zone at planting and hilling.

aminosan.desc: Tuberization and vegetative development in weekly applications.

revigophos-amino.desc: Phosphorus energy in 3 applications during filling.

fitofert.desc: Lowers physiological oxidation in 3 biweekly applications.

kmep-ultra.desc: Potentiates the insecticide and supplies potassium to the tuber.

batata.managementNote: KMEP Ultra is an insecticide potentiator: apply together with the pesticide, which also supplies potassium for tuber filling. Redutan at 30 ml/100 L as a spray conditioner.
batata.source: Juma-Agro brochure · Nutrition suggestions for potato

tomate.name: Tomato
tomate.description: Tomato demands nutrition from transplanting to harvest, with weekly and biweekly applications throughout the cycle. The Juma-Agro program organizes that calendar into five phases.
actua: Root and foliar system activation after transplanting.
Root zone conditioning with Aduban at day 20 and day 40.
Stress recovery and enzymatic metabolism activation in biweekly applications.
Phosphorus energy supply from 25 days after transplanting.
Better fruit firmness with calcium in weekly applications.
Potassium complement in 6 weekly applications.

0.title: Slow seedling establishment
0.desc: A seedling that takes long to root delays the whole field calendar.

1.title: Unbalanced plant
1.desc: A vegetative stage without base nutrition reaches flowering with no structure to hold the load.

2.title: Low fruit set
2.desc: Lack of boron and calcium at bloom drops flowers and reduces fruit count.

3.title: Blossom end rot and soft fruit
3.desc: Insufficient calcium at filling causes blossom end rot and loss of firmness.

4.title: Quality loss
4.desc: Fruit without firmness and potassium reaches the market with a short shelf life.

products.name: Revigo Boro 10
products.dose: 0.5 to 1.0 L/ha (1st at 60 days after transplanting, 2nd ten days later)

acorda-ultra.desc: Activates the root system at transplanting and the foliar system at day 50.

aduban.desc: Conditions the root zone 20 and 40 days after transplanting.

aminosan.desc: Stress recovery and enzymatic metabolism in biweekly applications.

revigophos-amino.desc: Phosphorus energy from 25 days after transplanting.

fitofert.desc: Endogenous defenses from vegetative stage to fruiting.

tomate.managementNote: KMEP Ultra 1.0 L/ha in 6 applications at weekly intervals, from vegetative development to harvest. Redutan Sili-4 at 30 ml/100 L as a spray conditioner.
tomate.source: Juma-Agro brochure · Nutrition suggestions for tomato (2025)

pastagem.name: Pasture
pastagem.description: Degraded pasture is one of the main problems for Brazilian ranchers. Juma-Agro offers a nutritional program for recovery, higher stocking, and weight gain.
actua: Recovery of degraded pastures with low density.
Stimulus for regrowth and tillering of forage grasses.
Nutrition for higher green mass production per hectare.
Nutritional quality of forage for better animal performance.
Higher stocking rate and weight gain per hectare.

0.title: Low density pasture
0.desc: Thin forage with weeds dominating and reducing carrying capacity.

1.title: Slow growth
1.desc: Pasture that does not respond to rain with rapid and uniform regrowth.

2.title: Low nutritional value forage
2.desc: Grass with low protein and energy content compromising animal performance.

revigo-pasto.desc: Complete program for pasture recovery and maintenance.

aminosan.desc: Vigor and resistance of forage grasses.
